_doc: GARUDA-FILIERA Batch A Lot 2 metadata-only cure for 56101 (innocence-violation finding, conductor-signed D6 verdict, session f5892d39, 2026-07-18). NOT a detach — 56101's per_skala substance was independently verified correct and is left completely untouched by this cure. The defect is in the PROVENANCE POINTER LIST and derived prose: canonical pp28_sources claimed ['56101','56104','56103','56109'], but the BPS crosswalk (Vol.2 Lampiran 5 p.211 / printed p.197; Lampiran 10 p.407) shows KBLI-2020 codes 56103 ('warung tenda') and 56104 (self-service/prasmanan) map to KBLI-2025 code 56102 ('Aktivitas Penyediaan Makanan di Bangunan Tidak Tetap'), never to 56101 — a permanent-building code. The true omitted ancestor of 56101 is KBLI-2020 code 56102 ('Rumah/Warung Makan'). Consequence: the pre-cure aggregation_note and intel_2026.whatChanged both misroute former-56103/56104 operators into believing this permanent-building code covers them, when their non-permanent-structure activity is actually 2025-56102. Compiler input for scripts/kbli_filiera/cure_metadata_pp28_sources.py (action correct_pp28_sources_metadata) — this compiler NEVER touches per_skala/per_skala_legacy, and refuses to run against a code that already carries a per_skala_disputed_* key (a metadata-only cure is only sound on an un-quarantined, innocence-confirmed record).
_provenance: Batch A plan §8 (Lot 2). Conductor-signed D6 verdict handed down directly (session f5892d39): 'pp28_sources ["56101","56104","56103","56109"] -> ["56101","56102","56109"] (BPS crosswalk L5 p.211/printed-197 + L10 p.407, conductor eye-verified: 56103+56104 map to 2025-56102, never 56101; true omitted source is 2020-56102 Rumah/Warung Makan)'. Also cured in this PR (value-in-place, apps/mouth/data/kbli-gold-all.json, NOT data-plane-guarded): gold.whatChanged carried the identical false claim ('Previous KBLI 2020 sources: 56101, 56104, 56103' — also silently dropping 56109) and masks intel_2026 on the live /kbli/56101 page, so the correction would otherwise be invisible on the served surface (49213/50115 precedent, commit 344a928bed).
whatChanged: Correction (2026-07-18): this code's merge list was fixed. The 2025 code 56101 (permanent-building restaurants) absorbs KBLI 2020 code 56102 (Rumah/Warung Makan — home-style eateries) and KBLI 2020 code 56109 (other fixed-building food) — that's it. If you previously operated under KBLI 2020 code 56103 (food stalls/tents) or 56104 (self-service/cafeteria restaurants), those are non-permanent-structure food activities and now fall under KBLI 2025 code 56102 ('Aktivitas Penyediaan Makanan di Bangunan Tidak Tetap'), not this code — check that page instead.

The true omitted ancestor is KBLI-2020 code 56102 ('Rumah/Warung Makan'). Corrected to ['56101','56102','56109'].
